column1: Collecting ants can be as simple as picking up stray ones and placing them in a glass jar, or as complicated as completing an exhaustive survey of all species present in an area and estimating their relative abundances.
column2: 采集蚂蚁可以很简单，捡起几只零散的蚂蚁放进玻璃罐就行；也可以很复杂，要全面调查一个地区的所有蚂蚁种类，并估算各物种的相对丰度。
column12: relative abundances|相对丰度；各物种个体数的相对多少

column1: The exact method used will depend on the final purpose of the collections.
column2: 具体采用哪种方法，取决于采集标本的最终目的。

column1: For taxonomy, or classification, long series, from a single nest, which contain all castes (workers, including majors and minors, and, if present, queens and males) are desirable, to allow the determination of variation within species.
column2: 做分类学研究（即研究如何给生物分类）时，来自同一蚁巢、涵盖各个品级的一大批标本（包括大型和小型工蚁，以及巢内若有的蚁后和雄蚁），是理想的研究材料，有助于确定同一物种内部的差异。
column5: long series|成系列的大量标本
column7: castes|n. 社会性昆虫的品级
column9: majors and minors|大型和小型工蚁

column1: For ecological studies, the most important factor is collecting identifiable samples of as many of the different species present as possible.
column2: 做生态学研究时，最重要的是尽可能多地采集当地不同物种的样本，并且这些样本要能够鉴定到种。

column1: Unfortunately, these methods are not always compatible.
column2: 遗憾的是，这些方法并不总能兼顾。
column6: compatible|adj. 可兼顾的；能同时适用的

column1: The taxonomist sometimes overlooks whole species in favour of those groups currently under study, while the ecologist often collects only a limited number of specimens of each species, thus reducing their value for taxonomic investigations.
column2: 分类学家有时只关注当前研究的类群，整个物种都可能被忽略；而生态学家往往对每个物种只采集少量标本，从而降低了这些标本对分类学研究的价值。
column5: in favour of|转而优先关注

column1: To collect as wide a range of species as possible, several methods must be used.
column2: 要采集到尽可能多种类的蚂蚁，必须采用多种方法。

column1: These include hand collecting, using baits to attract the ants, ground litter sampling, and the use of pitfall traps.
column2: 这些方法包括手工采集、用诱饵吸引蚂蚁、采集地表枯落物样本，以及设置陷阱采集。

column1: Hand collecting consists of searching for ants everywhere they are likely to occur.
column2: 手工采集就是在蚂蚁可能出现的每个地方搜寻它们。
column4: consists of|由……构成；具体做法是

column1: This includes on the ground, under rocks, logs or other objects on the ground, in rotten wood on the ground or on trees, in vegetation, on tree trunks and under bark.
column2: 要寻找的地方包括地面、地上的石块、倒木或其他物体下方，地上或树上的朽木中、植被中、树干上以及树皮下。

column1: When possible, collections should be made from nests or foraging columns and at least 20 to 25 individuals collected.
column2: 条件允许时，应从蚁巢或成列觅食的蚁群中采集，至少采集20至25只个体。

column1: This will ensure that all individuals are of the same species, and so increase their value for detailed studies.
column2: 这样能确保所有个体都属于同一物种，从而提高这些标本在深入研究中的价值。
column5: of the same species|属于同一物种

column1: Since some species are largely nocturnal, collecting should not be confined to daytime.
column2: 由于有些种类主要在夜间活动，采集不应局限在白天。

column1: Specimens are collected using an aspirator (often called a pooter), forceps, a fine, moistened paint brush, or fingers, if the ants are known not to sting.
column2: 采集标本可用吸虫器（常称为 pooter）、镊子或沾湿的细画笔；如果确定蚂蚁不会蜇人，也可以用手指。

column1: Individual insects are placed in plastic or glass tubes (1.5-3.0 ml capacity for small ants, 5-8 ml for larger ants) containing 75% to 95% ethanol.
column2: 昆虫被逐只放入盛有浓度为75%到95%的乙醇的塑料管或玻璃管中（小型蚂蚁用容量为1.5至3.0毫升的管，较大的蚂蚁用5至8毫升的管）。

column1: Plastic tubes with secure tops are better than glass because they are lighter, and do not break as easily if mishandled.
column2: 盖子牢靠的塑料管比玻璃管更合适，因为塑料管更轻，即使操作不当，也不像玻璃管那样容易破碎。

column1: Baits can be used to attract and concentrate foragers.
column2: 诱饵可以吸引外出觅食的蚂蚁，使它们聚集起来。

column1: This often increases the number of individuals collected and attracts species that are otherwise elusive.
column2: 这往往能增加采到的个体数量，还能引来用其他办法很难找到的物种。
column7: otherwise|adv. 用别的方法；在其他情况下

column1: Sugars and meats or oils will attract different species and a range should be utilised.
column2: 糖类和肉类或油脂会吸引不同的物种，因此应搭配使用多种诱饵。

column1: These baits can be placed either on the ground or on the trunks of trees or large shrubs.
column2: 这些诱饵既可以放在地面上，也可以放在乔木或大型灌木的主干上。

column1: When placed on the ground, baits should be situated on small paper cards or other flat, light-coloured surfaces, or in test-tubes or vials.
column2: 在地面放置诱饵时，应把诱饵放在小纸卡或其他平坦的浅色表面上，也可以放在试管或小瓶里。

column1: This makes it easier to spot ants and to capture them before they can escape into the surrounding leaf litter.
column2: 这样更容易发现蚂蚁，也更容易在它们逃进周围的落叶层之前将其捕获。

column1: Many ants are small and forage primarily in the layer of leaves and other debris on the ground.
column2: 许多蚂蚁体型很小，主要在地面的落叶和其他碎屑形成的枯落层中觅食。

column1: Collecting these species by hand can be difficult.
column2: 这些物种靠手工采集可能很困难。

column1: One of the most successful ways to collect them is to gather the leaf litter in which they are foraging and extract the ants from it.
column2: 采集它们最有效的方法之一，是收集它们正在其中觅食的落叶，再把蚂蚁从落叶中分离出来。
column3: one of the most successful ways|最有效的方法之一

column1: This is most commonly done by placing leaf litter on a screen over a large funnel, often under some heat.
column2: 最常见的做法是把落叶放在大漏斗上方的筛网上，往往还会适当加热。
column7: under some heat|在适度加热的条件下

column1: As the leaf litter dries from above, ants (and other animals) move downward and eventually fall out the bottom and are collected in alcohol placed below the funnel.
column2: 随着落叶从上面开始变干，蚂蚁和其他动物会向下移动，最后从漏斗底部掉出，落入下方盛放的酒精中，被收集起来。

column1: This method works especially well in rain forests and marshy areas.
column2: 这种方法在雨林和沼泽地带尤其有效。
column7: marshy|adj. 沼泽的；湿软多水的

column1: A method of improving the catch when using a funnel is to sift the leaf litter through a coarse screen before placing it above the funnel.
column2: 用漏斗采集时，有个办法能提高捕获量：在把落叶放到漏斗上方之前，先用粗筛网筛一遍。

column1: This will concentrate the litter and remove larger leaves and twigs.
column2: 这样能把较细的枯落物集中起来，筛去较大的叶片和细枝。

column1: It will also allow more litter to be sampled when using a limited number of funnels.
column2: 这样一来，即使漏斗数量有限，也能从更多的枯落物中取样。
column6: a limited number of|数量有限的

column1: The pitfall trap is another commonly used tool for collecting ants.
column2: 地面陷阱是另一种常用的蚂蚁采集工具。

column1: A pitfall trap can be any small container placed in the ground with the top level with the surrounding surface and filled with a preservative.
column2: 任何小容器都可以用作地面陷阱，只要埋在地里，开口与周围地面齐平，并装入保存液即可。

column1: Ants are collected when they fall into the trap while foraging.
column2: 蚂蚁在觅食时落入陷阱，便被收集起来。

column1: The diameter of the traps can vary from about 18 mm to 10 cm and the number used can vary from a few to several hundred.
column2: 陷阱的直径可以从约18毫米到10厘米不等，使用数量也可从几个到几百个不等。

column1: The size of the traps used is influenced largely by personal preference (although larger sizes are generally better), while the number will be determined by the study being undertaken.
column2: 所用陷阱的大小主要取决于个人偏好（尽管一般来说，大一些更好）；而使用数量则由所开展的研究决定。

column1: The preservative used is usually ethylene glycol or propylene glycol, as alcohol will evaporate quickly and the traps will dry out.
column2: 保存液通常用乙二醇或丙二醇，因为酒精挥发很快，陷阱里的液体就会干掉。

column1: One advantage of pitfall traps is that they can be used to collect over a period of time with minimal maintenance and intervention.
column2: 地面陷阱的一个优点是，只需很少的维护和人为干预，就能持续采集一段时间。
column5: over a period of time|持续一段时间

column1: One disadvantage is that some species are not collected as they either avoid the traps or do not commonly encounter them while foraging.
column2: 一个缺点是，有些物种采集不到，因为它们要么会避开陷阱，要么在觅食时很少遇到陷阱。
